SELECT q.id,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',(SELECT max(julianday(p.revealed_at)) FROM practice_items p
  WHERE p.version_id=q.current_version_id AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL)),CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM practice_items p WHERE p.version_id = q.current_version_id
  AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        FROM questions q
  JOIN topics t ON t.topic_id = q.topic_id
  JOIN question_versions v ON v.id = q.current_version_id
  LEFT JOIN question_user_state s ON s.question_id = q.id WHERE q.archived = @archived
  AND (@categoryKind = 'all'
  OR (@categoryKind = 'uncategorized' AND t.category_id IS NULL)
  OR (@categoryKind = 'category' AND t.category_id = @categoryId))
  AND (@topicId IS NULL OR q.topic_id = @topicId)
  AND (@tag IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(q.tags_json) WHERE value = @tag))
  AND (@personalTagId IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_personal_tags pt
    WHERE pt.question_id = q.id AND pt.tag_id = @personalTagId))
  AND (@difficulty IS NULL OR q.difficulty = @difficulty)
  AND (@favoritesOnly = 0 OR s.favorite = 1)
  AND (@practiceRecency='all' OR (@practiceRecency='never' AND (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM practice_items p WHERE p.version_id = q.current_version_id
  AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
    OR (@practiceRecency IN ('7d','30d') AND ((CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM practice_items p WHERE p.version_id = q.current_version_id
  AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0
      OR (SELECT max(julianday(p.revealed_at)) FROM practice_items p
  WHERE p.version_id=q.current_version_id AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL)<julianday(@practicedBefore))))
  AND (@mastery = 'all' OR (@mastery = 'unpracticed' AND (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM practice_items p WHERE p.version_id = q.current_version_id
  AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0)
    OR (@mastery = '不会＋不熟' AND (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IN ('不会', '不熟'))
    OR (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) = @mastery)
  AND (@query = '' OR instr(lower(q.title), lower(@query)) > 0
    OR instr(lower(v.question_markdown), lower(@query)) > 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(q.tags_json) WHERE instr(lower(value), lower(@query)) > 0)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN @practiceOrder='oldest' THEN
  CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM practice_items p WHERE p.version_id = q.current_version_id
  AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 0 WHEN (SELECT max(julianday(p.revealed_at)) FROM practice_items p
  WHERE p.version_id=q.current_version_id AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END END,
  CASE WHEN @practiceOrder='oldest' THEN (SELECT max(julianday(p.revealed_at)) FROM practice_items p
  WHERE p.version_id=q.current_version_id AND p.revealed_at IS NOT NULL) END,
  t.title,t.topic_id,q.position,q.id LIMIT 50

SELECT q.id,strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ',recentPractice.lastPracticeJulian),CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR recentPractice.revealedCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        FROM questions q
  JOIN topics t ON t.topic_id = q.topic_id
  JOIN question_versions v ON v.id = q.current_version_id
  LEFT JOIN question_user_state s ON s.question_id = q.id
      LEFT JOIN (SELECT version_id, count(*) AS revealedCount,
        max(julianday(revealed_at)) AS lastPracticeJulian
        FROM practice_items NOT INDEXED WHERE revealed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY version_id
      ) recentPractice ON recentPractice.version_id = q.current_version_id WHERE q.archived = @archived
  AND (@categoryKind = 'all'
  OR (@categoryKind = 'uncategorized' AND t.category_id IS NULL)
  OR (@categoryKind = 'category' AND t.category_id = @categoryId))
  AND (@topicId IS NULL OR q.topic_id = @topicId)
  AND (@tag IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(q.tags_json) WHERE value = @tag))
  AND (@personalTagId IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM question_personal_tags pt
    WHERE pt.question_id = q.id AND pt.tag_id = @personalTagId))
  AND (@difficulty IS NULL OR q.difficulty = @difficulty)
  AND (@favoritesOnly = 0 OR s.favorite = 1)
  AND (@practiceRecency='all' OR (@practiceRecency='never' AND (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR recentPractice.revealedCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)
    OR (@practiceRecency IN ('7d','30d') AND ((CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR recentPractice.revealedCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0
      OR recentPractice.lastPracticeJulian<julianday(@practicedBefore))))
  AND (@mastery = 'all' OR (@mastery = 'unpracticed' AND (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR recentPractice.revealedCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0)
    OR (@mastery = '不会＋不熟' AND (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IN ('不会', '不熟'))
    OR (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) = @mastery)
  AND (@query = '' OR instr(lower(q.title), lower(@query)) > 0
    OR instr(lower(v.question_markdown), lower(@query)) > 0
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(q.tags_json) WHERE instr(lower(value), lower(@query)) > 0)) ORDER BY CASE WHEN @practiceOrder='oldest' THEN
  CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN (CASE WHEN s.last_rated_version_id = q.current_version_id
  THEN s.last_rating ELSE NULL END) IS NOT NULL OR recentPractice.revealedCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0 THEN 0 WHEN recentPractice.lastPracticeJulian IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END END,
  CASE WHEN @practiceOrder='oldest' THEN recentPractice.lastPracticeJulian END,
  t.title,t.topic_id,q.position,q.id LIMIT 50
